identity_separation.unit_vs_location: organizational_units and physical_locations are separate trees; the only relation is unit_location_links (temporal)
identity_separation.temple: religious use of one location; not a Congregation, creates no organizational unit, no parent, no Territorial participation
identity_separation.centro_congregacao: Centro and Congregação stay organizational units; a building is never a unit

authority.engine: App\Domain\Territorial\TerritorialAuthority (the one scope engine) with data_type PHYSICAL
authority.rule: permission + active role + UNIT scope of the same grant (descendants when include_descendants=1) + ACTIVE unit_location_links row vigente now whose unit is covered
authority.unit_decisions: create location, link target and transfer destination require the unit itself to be covered
authority.anti_escalation: linking an existing location needs UNIT_LOCATION_LINK_MANAGE on the target unit AND prior authority over the location through another active link in scope
authority.order: permission held anywhere (403 otherwise, independent of the target) -> target resolved -> scope/link (404 otherwise)

cases: location without an ACTIVE vigente link

lifecycle.close_location_requires: no ACTIVE property or temple; forces PRIVATE

links.source_document_id: never accepted; new P0.7 links NULL; historic values preserved
links.last_active_link: LAST_ACTIVE_LINK_REQUIRED unless transfer or close_location in the same transaction
links.transfer: old link ENDED at t, new link starts at t (no gap, no overlap); audit old unit (transfer) + new unit (create), one correlation

occupation_types.meaning: how the unit occupies the location, not the building type

owner.owner_person: {kind: PERSON, person: {public_id, display_name}} only with independent PEOPLE_VIEW authority over that Person; otherwise {kind: PERSON, person: null}; never in lists

address.cipher: AES-256-GCM (P0.5 PeopleCrypto primitive and key ring), key_version per row, fail-closed
address.plaintext: GET /locations/{id}/address, PHYSICAL_LOCATION_MANAGE in scope, audited PHYSICAL_LOCATION_ADDRESS_READ
address.key_location: outside DB, code tree, Git and public directory (PHYSICAL_KEYRING_PATH, defaults to the P0.5 ring)

publication.coordinate_change: APPROVED_PUBLIC -> PRIVATE in the same transaction

concurrency.optimistic: lock_version on physical_locations, properties, temples, unit_location_links (STALE_WRITE)
concurrency.invariant_reads: locking reads (FOR UPDATE / FOR SHARE) so a concurrent commit is never missed by the transaction snapshot
concurrency.commit_time_recheck: actor/session + every decision (grants FOR SHARE) + link invariants + publication

audit.unit: unit of the authorizing active link; link operations: unit of the link changed

documents_files: out of scope (P0.8): no upload, download, property_documents, storage or files.classification interpretation
